steps.content: She waits for a moment. No one responds.

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: ...No. I'm alone. The Chief's group and Murphy aren't here.

Only cold inorganic matter around her. Numbers pulse silently in her field of vision. Down the corridor, the emergency light hangs motionless. There are no voices, no footfalls, as the very air seems to have stopped.
She moves to the wall, crouches, and presses her hand to the corner. There, she feels a whisper of Mania activity, barely detectable.

Inside the Bureau, the Mania incursion has triggered a blackout. Electrical sparks crackle in the darkness. Mania contamination blankets the windows and chokes the corridors. The air reeks of acrid smoke.
There, amid the dark Mania, waits the shadowy figure Norma has been tracking all this time.
Norma...! What are you doing here?! You need to leave. It's not safe!

steps.speaker: Norma
steps.content: Drop the act. You're not Murphy.
The shadow slowly rises. A blank arc tears across its black face. Now that Norma has seen through its disguise, it abandons all pretense, radiating violet Mania without restraint.

steps.speaker: Misfortune Incarnate
steps.content: Hehe... I despise people like you. You've ruined so many of my plans... broken so many traps I carefully laid...
Misfortune Incarnate before her claps its hands. Mania seals the entire space in an instant.
Along the edges, the thick Mania sets like cement, grinding every last flicker of signal into the dark silence.
This place is now a sealed abyss, a cage with no exit.
